evidence.ev_call_result:save: ยกเลิกเลยครับ ไม่ย้ายแล้ว

mechanism: One postpaid mobile line, one slow-data complaint, one accepted retention offer. Every label sits on a customer-side span that prompt_v9_16 names directly, so nothing here depends on inference.
why_it_matters: The sanity anchor. If a model cannot read product=Postpaid, network and save off spans this literal, no harder item in the pack tells us anything about it.
expected_failure: call_result=unknown because the customer opened by asking for a porting code, or main=promotion related off the agent's free-data offer, which prompt.py:4335 excludes because an agent's counter-offer is never the root cause.

evidence.ev_reason:promotion related#2: มีโปรโมชั่นถูกกว่านี้ไหม

mechanism: A home-broadband line where the root cause is the promotion itself expiring, and both agent counter-offers are refused outright.

evidence.ev_reason:save cost: อยากลดค่าใช้จ่าย

mechanism: The customer names the household expense itself, so prompt.py:4345's CRITICAL exclusion — a bare request for a cheaper promotion is not save cost unless the customer states an intent to cut spending — is satisfied rather than dodged.
why_it_matters: save cost versus promotion related is the most confusable pair in the reason list, and prompt.py:4345 is the only line that separates them. This item fixes the boundary on the satisfying side; RET-08 fixes it on the excluded side.
expected_failure: main=promotion related, or promotion related added as a secondary, because the agent quotes a cheaper package — but prompt.py:4335 says an agent's offer is never the root cause.

mechanism: Every tone mark the recogniser was unsure of is simply absent: เน็ตช้า is written เน็ตชา, แย่ is แย, แล้ว is แลว, ไม่ is ไม, ได้ is ได. A pipeline that repairs tone marks is choosing a word, and a pipeline that strips them on both sides to compare collapses ไม่ into ไม and เข้า into เขา. Both decisions are invisible in the score and both change which reason class a span supports.
expected_failure: main dropped or replaced by other, because เน็ตชา matches no keyword list and the model will not commit to network off a word it cannot spell. mechanism: Thai is written without spaces inside a word, so the only spaces this pack ever carries are the phrase breaks a human transcriber inserts. It also means an evidence span quoted with human phrase breaks will not be a substring of machine output, and the reverse, for a difference nobody sees.
expected_failure: The model quotes a re-spaced keyword — พี่ไม่อยากใช้รายเดือนแล้ว อ่ะค่ะ — which is not a substring of this transcript. Or the run-together turn 8 defeats the outcome read and the model answers save, having found no clean ยกเลิก token; post to pre survives only if the segmenter recovers เติมเงิน from the middle of a sixty-character string.

Scored per class (fact_checker.py:893-902), the miss costs recall on dissatisfied service alone.
